_about: Hand-kept tables, read by the recorder (name matching) and the site (math). Aliases are normalised: lowercase, alphanumerics only, with 'nvidia', 'geforce' and 'tesla' removed. Entries marked verify:true are best guesses as of 2026-11-03.
publish_raw_note: Sources whose raw hourly data may go in the public archive; everything else goes to the private archive. See 'Sources and their terms' in the README (checked 2026-11-04).

skip_sources.vast: Vast's Terms of Use (2026-09-01) forbid automated retrieval and using its data for a pricing-comparison service without a written agreement.
skip_sources.runpod: RunPod's Terms of Service (2026-03-24) forbid automated access and systematic retrieval to compile a database.

vast.note: Vast replaced its host fee with an unstated internal surcharge; third parties say ~15%.

clore.note: 10% on-demand base fee; +15% hoster fee when paid in BTC/USDT/USDC instead of CLORE.

nicehash.note: Seller payout fee to a NiceHash wallet.

mrr.note: Sources disagree on who pays the 3%.

terms_note.vast: Vast bans mining on credit bought by card.
